summary: The host straightens up from the burning oven, clutches his head in panic, thinks with a finger at his mouth, then heads right toward the window.
framing: Medium shot, side-on in the kitchen: host at left by the open oven. Camera tilts up as he stands (425-429) to a waist-up framing with the stove top at the bottom right, then pans right with him from 470 until the window enters at the right.

cast.visible: full upper body bent over, then waist up
cast.costume: light-blue suit, lilac shirt, pink tie, white frilled apron tied at the back

props: white oven with its door open downward (424-426), smoke and the red roast inside
stove top upstand with knobs at the bottom right
lilac wall cupboards at the left
kitchen sash window, enters from the right from 473

beats.action: bent over at the waist facing right, both hands low on the open oven door, looking down into the oven, apron bow at his back
thick dark-grey smoke rises from the oven behind him up the wall; smoke also fills the oven mouth
tilt up following the host as he stands; oven sinks to the bottom of frame
begins to rise, hands still on the oven door
half upright, turned 3/4 to camera, right hand up at his open mouth, eyes wide looking right; left hand still down on the oven
upright; right hand claps to the side of his head (elbow high, screen left), mouth open, eyes wide to the right
holds hand-on-head pose, head tilted toward the hand, eyes wide, speaking
smoke column keeps rising and spreading behind him, slowly changing shape; a second plume comes off the stove top
head turns a little more to the right, mouth 'o'
teeth clenched, eyes wide front-right
head turns to near profile right, mouth 'o', looking off right
head back 3/4, mouth open then teeth clenched, eyes wide
hand slides down from head to cheek, eyelids drop to half, brows level; other arm reaches out right, hand flat on the stove top
both hands come up in front of him, fingers curled; eyes shut, teeth clenched, head upright
eyes open looking sideways to the right; right hand goes up to his mouth, left fist held at his chest
index finger hooked against his lips, eyes slid right under half-lowered lids (thinking); holds
mouth closes on the finger; brow lowers
hand lifts off the mouth slightly, fingers loosening
pan right, following the host; cupboards slide off left, window enters at right from 473
hand drops away open, body turns toward the right, mouth closed in a frown
walks right in profile, leaning forward, arms lowering to his sides, eyes ahead
keeps walking right toward the window, back partly to camera, eyes wide looking at the window; apron bow visible at his back

notes: Camera: tilt at 425-429 and pan from 470 both agree with timeline.json; the pan is still moving on the last frame (483). The hand on the head is the screen-left one (his right). During 428-453 the body is still and only the head and mouth move. Smoke is a translucent dark-grey layer in front of the wall and behind the host.
